other_med_considered_list_v2: Sodium Bicarbonate, Nebulized bronchodilator (COPD), IV Fluids (post-ROSC)
comments_v2: Prompt role assignment following EMS handoff (01:02). High-quality chest compressions started at 01:20 with minimal peri-check pauses (4s pause at 03:52 and 4s pause at 06:06; chest compression fraction ~98.1%). PEA was immediately recognized as non-shockable (01:22). Epinephrine 1 mg IV was administered promptly at 01:44 and repeated at 04:03. LMA/advanced airway was placed at 01:50 and confirmed via bilateral lung auscultation at 03:24. H's and T's (hypoxia, pulmonary embolism, electrolyte derangement/hypovolemia from diarrhea, acidosis, hypoglycemia) were systematically reviewed. ROSC was achieved at 06:09 with appropriate post-arrest care (IV fluids, 12-lead ECG, chest X-ray, head CT, and specialist consultations).
feedback_narrative_v2:
1. Immediate Recognition & High-Quality CPR: Following EMS handoff at 01:02, the Team Leader rapidly assigned roles and initiated chest compressions at 01:20. The team maintained continuous compressions with a 98.1% compression fraction and ultra-short 4-second pauses for pulse/rhythm checks at 03:52 and 06:06.
2. ACLS Non-Shockable Algorithm Adherence: The Team Leader explicitly verbalized at 01:22 that PEA is a non-shockable rhythm and prioritized early epinephrine (1st dose at 01:44, 2nd dose at 04:03) and airway placement (01:50).
3. Opportunities for Improvement: While airway placement was verbalized at 01:50, auscultation of bilateral breath sounds to confirm placement was delayed until 03:17–03:24 (87 seconds later). Additionally, sodium bicarbonate was suggested twice (04:06 and 05:51) without a closed-loop order or confirmation of administration, and compressor switching was not performed at the 2-minute mark.
general_comments_v2: The Team Leader maintained a calm, composed demeanor and regularly solicited input from the team ('does anybody have any other suggestions?' at 03:09, 05:49). Closed-loop communication was strong for epinephrine administration (01:44, 04:03) and lung auscultation (03:17), though ancillary medication suggestions (sodium bicarbonate at 04:06, 05:51) were floated without direct assignment or confirmation.
